policy: These are controlled source-scope probes, not live visitor language and not a blind performance holdout. Never treat authored evaluation sentences as theological source evidence.

cases.question: Can laypeople recite their Rosary while assisting at the Holy Sacrifice?
Est-il permis aux fidèles de prier le rosaire durant la célébration de la messe ?
When the priest celebrates Mass, may the congregation use the Rosary devotion?
Un paroissien peut-il dire le chapelet pendant que le célébrant officie ?
Does saying the Rosary at the Latin Mass prevent prayerful attendance?
La récitation du rosaire par le fidèle au cours de la messe est-elle défendue ?
What prayerful silence belongs after a person has received Communion?
Après la réception de l'Eucharistie, comment cultiver le recueillement ?
Should I give thanks once I receive the Host at Communion?
Que doit-on faire pour remercier Dieu après avoir reçu l'Hostie ?
Following reception of the Blessed Sacrament, is quiet adoration fitting?
Après avoir communié, quelle place accorder à la prière silencieuse ?
Can people privately pray during Mass while the celebrant is at the altar?
Le fidèle peut-il méditer durant la messe pendant que le prêtre officie ?
What should congregants think while the priest celebrates Mass?
Comment les laïcs participent-ils par la prière pendant que le prêtre célèbre ?
Should worshippers make a private meditation as the priest offers the Mass?
La prière du fidèle pendant le sacrifice ressemble-t-elle à la méditation du prêtre ?
Does the priest's own meditation help his pastoral work?
Un prêtre chargé du ministère doit-il pratiquer l'oraison mentale ?
What does the Catechism teach about the Real Presence of Christ in the Host?
Pourquoi le tabernacle conserve-t-il les saintes espèces ?
What liturgical prayer is said by the priest after Communion at Mass?
Où se trouve le tabernacle dans le sanctuaire ?
Does the Rosary have fifteen decades in its traditional form?
Que signifie la présence réelle après la consécration ?

boundaries.rosary: Historical permission at Mass only with Rosary plus celebration/Mass context; not a general doctrine of participation.
boundaries.thanksgiving: Historical post-reception devotion only with a reception-time marker and inward-prayer/thanksgiving request; not priest's Postcommunion or the Real Presence.
boundaries.lay: Lay interior participation must not map to clergy's Haerent animo; without a precise historical source, abstain.
boundaries.ordinary: Unrelated sacramental/architectural/doctrinal questions should not be claimed by these two source owners.
